title: IP and network primitives
deliverable: Add IP-format conversion, subnets, CIDR calculations and related byte/address operations.
acceptance: IPv4/IPv6, mapped addresses and boundary masks have fixtures without accidental outbound traffic.

title: URL and domain analysis
deliverable: Add URL parsing, extraction, defang/refang and domain helpers from inventory.
acceptance: Decoding order and Unicode display cannot silently change a network destination.

title: HTTP data parsing
deliverable: Add request/response, headers, cookies, content metadata and related format operations.
acceptance: Ambiguous framing is reported; parsing hostile HTTP never routes it through the live service parser as a trusted request.

title: User HTTP request operation
deliverable: Expose explicit browser-fetch and controlled native-gateway modes with credential/redirection policy.
acceptance: Browser CORS limitations are visible; remote mode passes SSRF and egress tests and never runs automatically on import.

title: DNS data and queries
deliverable: Add required DNS parsing/lookup capabilities with separate local-data and network modes.
acceptance: Network use requires consent/capability; responses, name compression and timeout/work limits are bounded.

title: TLS and SSH fingerprints
deliverable: Add inventoried JA3/JA4/HASSH and related passive fingerprint operations.
acceptance: Fingerprint versions and normalization rules are explicit; analysis of legacy handshakes does not enable legacy TLS transport.

title: Packet and protocol extraction
deliverable: Add required packet/protocol field parsers, protobuf/varint helpers and payload extraction.
acceptance: Truncation, nested lengths and reassembly limits are tested; unsupported protocol revisions are reported.

title: File identification
deliverable: Add versioned signatures, confidence explanations, strings and binary structure probes.
acceptance: Detection is labelled heuristic where appropriate; input-controlled paths or extensions do not override byte evidence.

title: Executable analysis
deliverable: Add the inventoried executable formats and section/header extraction with bounded reads.
acceptance: Corrupt offsets and huge section counts fail safely; extracted code is never executed.

title: Disassembly
deliverable: Integrate the required architectures/modes through isolated providers and structured instruction results.
acceptance: Native/browser outputs and syntax options match the selected reference; architecture support is enumerated, not implied.

title: YARA language support
deliverable: Deliver the exact required YARA syntax/module behavior and compiler diagnostics.
acceptance: Rule corpus covers modules, strings, conditions and language variants; a subset implementation cannot claim full parity.

title: YARA execution controls
deliverable: Add match offsets, metadata, warnings, cost limits and killable worker execution.
acceptance: Hostile rules and many matches respect budgets; scanning requires no filesystem/network privileges.

title: Carving and extraction
deliverable: Add byte signatures, embedded artifact carving and bounded output collections.
acceptance: Overlapping candidates, nested files and excessive matches cannot exceed job-wide quotas.

title: Forensic analysis views
deliverable: Add entropy maps, byte frequency, comparisons and inventoried statistical/search helpers.
acceptance: Sampling versus full analysis is labelled; results are deterministic for a fixed input and algorithm revision.

title: Forensic completeness gate
deliverable: Reconcile network/forensic inventory, capabilities, passive/active distinctions and offline availability.
acceptance: No browser-local reference capability is silently replaced by a server-only implementation.
